name: field-repeater
title: Field repeater
description: An 'Add another' group of fields that repeats row by row, with add, remove, a minimum and maximum, and focus that lands in the new row.
docs: Give it value and onChange (or defaultValue, and the text stays in uncontrolled inputs), a createItem that makes a row with a new id every time, and a renderRow that draws the fields of one row. The third argument of renderRow has the row's number, its name ("Contact 2") and update(patch). Rows are keyed by item.id, so typed text stays with its row when a row above is removed. After Add, focus lands on the first field of the new row; after Remove, on the row that took its place, or on Add when none is left. A polite status says "Contact 3 added" or "Contact 2 removed". At max, Add is off and says why; at min, Remove is not shown; an empty list is one dashed Add row. itemLabel, itemsLabel, addLabel and labels carry the words.
